minimality.reason_one_row_suffices: dynamics generates two independent odd Krylov functionals
minimality.required_quantity: rank of the restricted observability matrix, not raw row count

source_test.completion: bound the two restricted Gramians uniformly; the full bound is their minimum when cross terms vanish
source_test.second: compute character projections J_even=(J+JR)/2 and J_odd=(J-JR)/2
source_test.third: run observability/PBH separately on V_even and V_odd

verdict: For C2-equivariant dynamics, observability decomposes by sheet character. A pure even Clark output can never observe an odd invariant state, regardless of propagation time. A genuinely odd seam row can observe the whole odd block through its Krylov orbit. Two sheet-related measurements help only when their orbit contains both nonzero character projections.
